paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen a:
heading: TOUPA Puanin Tundingna Leh Latna

paite: "Kha masapen ani masapen in kihoupihna biakbuk na dingsakta ding ahi.
Huai sung ah theihpihna bawm na koih dia, bawm puanzak in na khuh ding ahi.
Dohkan na lalut dia, atung ah thil kizom akoih dingte kizom in na koih ding a; khawnvak koihna na lalut dia, akhawnvakte na det ding ahi.
Theihpihna bawm ma ah gimlim a dia dangka-eng maitam na koih dia, kongkhak puankhai biakbuk ah na koih ding ahi.
Kihoupihna puanin biakbuk kongkhak ma ah halmang thillat maitam na koih ding ahi.
Kihoupihna puanin leh maitam kikal ah tuikuang na koih dia, huai ah tui na koih ding ahi.
Akimvel in huangsung na bawl dia, huangsung kongpi ah puankhai na khaitou ding ahi.
"Thaunilhna sathau na la dia, biakbuk na nilh ding a; huai sung a om tengteng toh, na hihsiangthou dia, atui-um belsuan tengteng asiangthou ding hi.
Haltum thillat maitam na nilh ding a; atui-um belsuan tengteng toh, maitam na siangthousak ding. Huchi in maitam asiangthou penpen ding hi.
Tuikuang leh akhe na nilh dia, na siangsak ding ahi.
"Kihoupihna puanin kongkhak ah Aaron leh atapate na hon pi dia, tui in na sil ding ahi.
Puan siangthoute Aaron na silhsak dia, na nilh dia, na siangthousak ding ahi; siampu nasepna mun a ka nna aseptheihna ding in.
Atapate na hon tonpih dia, puanak tung na silhsak ding ahi.
Apa uh sathau na nilh bang in amau siampu nasepna mun a, ka nna aseptheihna ding un thau na nilh ding ahi. Athaunilhna uh akhang-akhang ua siampu hihna ahih taktak ding ziak in," achi hi.
Hiai bang in Mosi in ahihta a; TOUPA'N amah thu apiak bang zel in ahi, ahih.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, akum nihna, akha masapen, huai kha a ani masapen ni in, biakbuk dinsak in a-omta hi.
Mosi in biakbuk adingsakta a, akingakna khuakkuakte ahen a, asingpekte atung a, azawlte athunlut a, akhuamte adingsak hi.
Biakbuk tung ah puanin azalhta a; atunglam ah puanin khuhna akoih a; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in ahihta hi.
Theihpihna ala a bawm sung ah akoih a, bawm tung ah azawlte akoih a; bawm tunglam ah zahngaihna tutphah akoih hi.
Bawm biakbuk sung ah atawilut a, khuhna puanzak azak a, theihpihna bawm akhuh hi. TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in ahihta.
Kihoupihna puanin sung ah biakbuk pang mallam, puanzak polam ah dohkan akoih hi.
TOUPA ma ah dohkan tung ah tanghoute kizom in akoih a; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in akoih hi.
Kihoupihna puanin sung ah dohkan zawn ah, biakbuk sik simlam pang ah khawnvak koihna akoih hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in TOUPA ma ah khawnvakte det ahi.
Huan puanzak ma ah kihoupihna biakbuk sung ah dangka-eng maitam akoih hi:
TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in, huai tung ah gimlim ahal hi.
Biakbuk kongkhak ah puankhai akhai hi.
Kihoupihna puanin biakbuk kongkhak kiang ah TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in halmang thillat leh tangbuang thillat alan hi.
Kihoupihna puanin leh maitam kikal ah kisawpna ding in tuikuang akoih a, huai ah tui akoih hi.
Mosi leh Aaron leh atapate'n akhutte uh leh akhepekte uh huai ah asil uhi.
Kihoupihna puanin sung ah ahoh ua, maitam kiang ah ahong pai nai ua TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in akisil uhi.
Biakbuk leh maitam kimvel in huangsung abawl a, huangsung kongpi puankhaite akhaita hi. Huchi in Mosi in nasep azouta hi.
Huai khit in meipi in kihoupihna biakbuk atuam a, TOUPA thupina in biakbuk adimsak hi.
heading: TOUPA Omna Puanin Tung A Meipi / (Nam 9.15-23)

paite: Huchi in kihoupihna biakbuk sung ah Mosi alut theita kei; atung a meipi akai ziak in leh TOUPA thupina in biakbuk adimsak ziak in.
Biakbuk tung a pan meipi laktouh a a-om chiang in, Israel suante akhualzinna uah malam ah apai zel uhi.
Himahleh meipi laktouh a a-om louh chiang in, akilaktouh louh ni in azin kei uhi.
Akhualzin sung teng uh Israel inkote mitmuh in sun in biakbuk tung ah meipi in TOUPA a-om a, zan in biakbuk tung ah meikuang in a-om hi.
